audience: adults considering an evening course this spring

copy_lines.text: Kurs som passer en travel hverdag

hypothesis: a real instructor on camera lifts sign-ups versus a generic promo
insight: a real instructor on camera builds the trust a sign-up needs

maker_recommendation.rationale: a human video needs only 16 more sign-ups to pay off, about 6% of the goal, so the human version is easily justified

mandatories.text: Do not present an AI actor as a real instructor.
For EU reach, label realistic AI-made people under Article 50.

open_questions: Decide flags 250 sign-ups on 40 000 kr as a stretch at the assumed conversion rate; is the target or budget firm?
proposition: an honest look at the course that earns 250 sign-ups
